description.purpose: Describe retained channel/video metadata and caption observations.
description.limitations: TinyDB cache rows and SDK/yt-dlp saved representations remain owned by youtube_api. Source models allow unknown publisher fields; no exact HTTP envelope or native physical table mapping is declared. Failure/unknown is not absence; caption negatives are scoped English WebVTT observations.

schema.dataGranularityDescription: One literal configured/retained handle row bound to verified channel ID, retaining full current SDK item.

properties.description: Verified configured/retained returned channel ID; unavailable legacy value stays absent.
